topic: process split and boot: api vs ws processes, cluster workers, scheduled jobs
hint: TYPE comes from argv --api/--ws; schedulers only start in the api primary; customRedisFlush differs by TYPE using WS_KEYS.

topic: REST authentication: token to session to cached user, IP ban checks, bots vs users
hint: token is a header-stripped JWT of sessionId-passwordVersion looked up via SESSION_ID_TO_USER_ID with a Lua script; bot tokens are minted by getBotToken.

topic: socket authentication and initial AUTHENTICATED payload, room joining and auth queue
hint: auth handled through a concurrency-1 PQueue with position events; channel rooms joined by PUBLIC_CHANNEL bit or ADMIN.

topic: message creation pipeline: route validation, createMessage, mentions, emits, push notifications
hint: createMessage is an alias of createMessageV2 in Message.ts; side effects run after the response without awaiting; shadowBanned users get a fake response.

topic: permissions: role bits, channel permission bits, middleware chain
hint: channel permissions are per-member cached in a redis hash (24h) and merged from role channel permissions; owner and ADMIN role bypass.

topic: rate limiting and auto-ban on repeated limit hits
hint: Lua script in RateLimitCache; DEV_MODE disables rate limit unless body.test_enable_rate_limit; onThreeIterations bans server members spamming messages.

topic: voice channels and calls: join/leave, signalling, TURN credentials
hint: join requires the socketId to map to the user in redis; onDisconnect leaves voice only when the voice socket is the one disconnecting.

topic: webhooks and bot applications: webhook tokens, execute endpoints, message creator overrides, OAuth2 grants
hint: webhook token uses JWT_WEBHOOK_SECRET; webhook delete only marks deleting=true and index.ts purges messages in batches.

topic: deferred deletion and cleanup jobs: servers, accounts, channels, attachments, suspensions
hint: server deletion waits 5 days via scheduleServerDelete; perm-suspended accounts deleted after 15 days; message deletes in batches of 300 per minute.

topic: file uploads and attachments through the external Nerimity CDN
hint: API never receives file bytes for messages: client uploads to CDN with a token, then sends nerimityCdnFileId which verifyUpload checks.
